description: List feature flags with their status, rollout, rules, and variants: a website's flags when a website is given, otherwise the organization-wide flags. Flag IDs are used by update_flag and add_users_to_flag.

limit.description: Maximum items to return, 1-100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

status.description: Only return flags with this status.

name: list_flags
title: List flags
